messages:
dorothy_customer: Hi team — customer reporting missing trace links in the console. They have a correlation id but the trace panel returns ‘no trace found’. Screenshot: https://img.redwood/ds/snap1.png

alice_support: thanks. can you paste the corr id and an example timestamp? we'll triage.

dorothy_customer: corr-id=abc123-def456, seen at 2024-11-02T15:23:40Z. logs show the request finished, but trace viewer shows nothing. sample curl we used to generate: ```curl -X POST https://api.example.com/checkout -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -H 'X-Correlation-ID: abc123-def456' --data-binary @bigpayload.bin```

deploy-bot: ticket #5423 created for support escalation.

ben_eng: looking. quick check: our trace-stitcher expects X-Correlation-ID to be present at the edge and passed to the trace ingestion pipeline. If the header is missing we can't link spans to request IDs.

dorothy_customer: we confirmed the header appears in our app logs but not in upstream traces. payload size ~12MB.

chris_sre: that size rings a bell — our GCLB / ingress has a header passthrough cutoff; non-standard headers can get dropped for large bodies in the default config. repro script below: ```# repro: send big body with custom header
curl -v -X POST https://staging.redwood.internal/echo -H 'X-Correlation-ID: abc123-def456' --data-binary @12mb.bin
# server log shows header present on backend, but upstream proxy log shows header absent
```

ben_eng: confirmed locally — when payload >8MB the proxy strips custom headers. stitcher queries by X-Correlation-ID and then looks up spans by trace id; without the header there is no correlation key so trace view shows gap.

dorothy_customer: ouch. any workaround?

alice_support: shared a short-term workaround: have your service echo a standard header the proxy preserves (e.g., Server-Timestamp) or include correlation id in response body so frontend can surface a fallback link. we sent steps to customer. :thumbsup:

chris_sre: long-term fix options: 1) change ingress config to disable header-dropping for our custom headers, 2) add a secondary linking path in the stitcher (fall back to request path + timestamp similarity), or 3) have runtime attach a Redwood-trace-id header from the agent before the proxy stage. I'll open infra task.

ben_eng: created internal issue INF-2871 to add fallback lookup + telemetry. also adding detection to console to show ‘header missing — possible proxy strip’ with a hint and link to KB.

alice_support: passing the workaround to customer; they confirmed they can reduce chunk size for now. closing the immediate escalation but keeping the internal tickets open.

dorothy_customer: confirmed workaround works for us. thanks for the quick turnaround.
